subject: Observability & Ops onboarding — AcmeHealth workshop coordination
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Nov 2028 09:15 -0800
Subject: Observability & Ops onboarding — AcmeHealth workshop coordination

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. We’re ready to kick off the observability & ops onboarding and want to align on a short workshop to cover dashboards, tracing hooks, error taxonomy, alert routing, and runbooks. Proposed agenda (45–60m):

- Quick intro & goals (5m)
- Current instrumentation & gaps (10m)
- Dashboard baseline & template walk-through (10m)
- Tracing spans / naming / sampling strategy (10m)
- Alerts, priorities, and routing (10m)
- Next steps & action owners (5m)

Can you confirm:
1) Which environment we should operate on for the workshop (prod / staging / both)?
2) Whether you want pager/email/Slack for P0/P1 notifications (and any on-call rotations we should know about).

I’ve attached an intake sheet to collect current alert lists and access details (acme-observability-intake.xlsx). Suggested window: week of Nov 6 — we have an opening on Tue Nov 7 at 2:00pm ET (11:00am PT). If that works, I’ll send the calendar invite and link our implementation playbook.

Ben will lead the alert taxonomy and runbook mapping; Laura will lead dashboards and tracing hooks. I’ll coordinate logistics and follow-ups.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: acme-observability-intake.xlsx

From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Nov 2028 10:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability & Ops onboarding — AcmeHealth workshop coordination

Hi Marissa —

Thanks, that agenda looks great. Confirming:
- Environment: run the workshop against staging but we can reference production dashboards.
- Notifications: P0 -> phone + page + Slack (#oncall); P1 -> email + Slack; P2 -> email. We use PagerDuty for paging.

I attached our current exported alert list (acme-current-alerts.csv) — it has the alert names, current severity mapping (we know it’s a bit inconsistent), and owners.

Tue Nov 7 at 2:00pm ET works for me. Please include ops-team@acmehealth.com so we have the platform engineers on the call.

Sam
Sam Torres
Director, Platform Engineering
AcmeHealth

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sam Torres <sam.torres@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Nov 2028 11:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability & Ops onboarding — AcmeHealth workshop coordination

Perfect — thanks Sam. I’ve booked Tue Nov 7, 2:00pm ET and sent a calendar invite to everyone including ops-team@acmehealth.com. Invite includes the meeting doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2B3C-acme-onboarding-plan (agenda + pre-reads).

Action owners for the session:
- Laura Bennett (Dashboards & tracing hooks): lead walkthrough and propose a starter dashboard layout and span naming conventions.
- Ben Carter (Alerts & runbooks): present initial alert taxonomy and runbook template; gather preferences on paging/channeling.
- Marissa (me): capture decisions, update the onboarding playbook, and coordinate follow-ups (ONB-112).

Ben — could you draft an initial alert taxonomy (P0/P1/P2 definitions + suggested routing) and attach a sample runbook we can iterate on before Tue? If we can get a v1 by end of day Monday (Nov 6) that helps us hit the ground running.

Laura — can you list any instrumentation gaps we commonly see (span name mismatches, missing service tags, sampling settings) so we can ask the ops team to grant access ahead of time?

Thanks all — looking forward to the workshop.

—
Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Torres <sam.torres@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Nov 2028 09:30 -0800
Subject: ACME — initial alert taxonomy + runbook samples (v1)

Marissa / Laura / Sam —

Attaching a first pass: acme-alert-taxonomy-v1.docx and a simple runbook (acme-api-degraded-runbook.md). High-level notes:

- P0: Service unavailable / sustained 5xx spike (>5m) OR latency > 5s on business-critical endpoints -> Page + Slack + Email -> oncall -> SRE responder.
- P1: Elevated error rate / cache degradation -> Email + Slack -> app owner.
- P2: Non-urgent policy/metric drift -> Email to owners.

Questions for Acme ops team before the workshop:
1) Datadog access: can you grant Redwood read/viewer on the staging org (ops-team@acmehealth.com is the contact we need)?
2) Trace spans: we prefer service.operation span naming (service:name.operation). Are you currently using that pattern?
3) Notification channels: confirm PagerDuty integration and existing escalation policies (we can mirror or propose changes).

If we get answers to those, I’ll refine the taxonomy and pre-populate the runbook template with play-by-play steps (investigate, rollback toggle, mitigation steps, postmortem owner).

—
Ben Carter
Solutions Architect, Customer Ops | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Attachments: acme-alert-taxonomy-v1.docx; acme-api-degraded-runbook.md

From: Sam Torres <sam.torres@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Nov 2028 15:40 -0800
Subject: Re: ACME — initial alert taxonomy + runbook samples (v1)

Thanks Ben — this is helpful and the taxonomy aligns with what we want. A few quick items:

- Datadog: I’ve added ops-team@acmehealth.com as the contact; we’ll invite redwood-viewer@acmehealth-datadog to the staging org before the meeting (expect invite by EOD Mon Nov 6).
- Trace naming: we currently have a mixture; we can map to your preferred service.operation pattern but will need to run a small rename migration for a couple services.
- PagerDuty: yes, we have an existing escalation policy for critical incidents; I’ll share the PD URL in the invite notes.

We’re all set for Tue at 2:00pm ET — please include the workshop link and the onboarding doc in the invite. Looking forward to it.

Sam
